g.text: Differential expression, PD vs GM — all T cells
n = 21 samples (13 GM / 8 PD); 10796 genes after filtering. TMM-normalised.
Dashed lines: |log2FC| = 1. Colour = BH-adjusted significance; y-axis = unadjusted p.
Immunoglobulin genes excluded (ambient, donor-driven). Yellow outlined: genes of interest, labelled regardless of significance.
NOTE: whole-compartment pseudobulk is confounded by cluster composition; see per-cluster results.
